tools.name: analyze_solar_quote
tools.description: Analyze a residential solar proposal for clarity and completeness before a homeowner signs. Returns a Quote Clarity Score (0-100) across four dimensions, an overall rating, red flags, missing information, questions to ask the installer, and a recommended next step. Illustrative educational decision-support only — not legal, tax, financial, or engineering advice, does not guarantee savings or system performance, and takes no consequential action.

inputSchema.description: Fields extracted from a residential solar proposal. All fields are optional. Provide numbers without currency or percent symbols.

cashPrice.description: Total cash price for the system in USD.

financedPrice.description: Total financed price in USD, if different from cash.

annualProductionEstimate.description: Quoted annual production estimate in kWh.

annualUsageAvailable.description: True if sizing was confirmed against actual annual kWh usage.

batteryIncluded.description: True if a battery is included.

batteryPriceSeparate.description: Battery cost as a separate line item in USD.

panelUpgradeCost.description: Electrical panel upgrade cost in USD.

otherAddonsCost.description: Other itemized add-on costs in USD.

financeType.description: How the system is paid for.

escalatorPct.description: Annual payment escalator percentage (0 if none).

totalPayments.description: Total of all payments over the term in USD.

earlyPayoffTermsShown.description: True if early payoff terms are disclosed.

buyoutLanguageShown.description: True if lease/PPA buyout language is present.

transferLanguageShown.description: True if contract transfer terms are disclosed.

installerAddressShown.description: True if a physical installer address is shown.

warrantyRegistrationExplained.description: True if warranty registration is explained.

bondInsuranceShown.description: True if bond/insurance documentation is shown.

ptoResponsibilityShown.description: True if PTO/interconnection responsibility is stated.

cancellationInfoShown.description: True if cancellation/rescission rights are shown.
